curriculum.ranking: Common full-DAG density candidates and exact 8-lesson/4-pass DP; includes mapping/root costs and canonical aliases.
curriculum.sourceOrderPolicy: Original identities retained; all lesson positions optimized with a shared full prerequisite DAG.
curriculum.extensionRationale: 当前课程字词未使用这些字根；保留为完整字根表扩展，在全部当前字词之后学习。
curriculum.table: 声母首笔字根字词学习表.tsv

tableColumns.ID: 稳定学习标识，独立于课程位置；筛选和移除旧规则课后允许不连续。
tableColumns.sourceId: 原表学习序号；映射和字根为空
tableColumns.dependencies IDs: 直接前置学习项目 ID，空格分隔
tableColumns.root coverage: 本项目涉及的全部去重字根 ID，空格分隔；字根项目指向自身
tableColumns.kind: 字根为 core/extension；原字词保留原类型
tableColumns.code: 比较与输入用的小写编码；字根使用完整三位 ASB
tableColumns.displayCode: 按 A 大写、S/B 小写显示的本项答案
tableColumns.fullCode: 字根官方完整 ASB 的小写编码
tableColumns.fullDisplayCode: 字根官方完整 ASB 的角色大小写显示

curriculum.rootPractice: 完整 ASB；同形同码汉字通过 practiceAlias 共用字根练习和复习，不重复出题。
curriculum.silentRootRule: 无读音字根的小码同补码；并入字根初识，不另设规则课。
curriculum.rootWeighting: Sum reciprocal lexical ranks of active downstream vocabulary; same definition for both courses.

optimization.objective: Minimize sum(rank-reciprocal lexical weight * independently practised lesson completion position). Includes mapping/root cost; aliases cost once.
optimization.limits: Heuristic and local exact optimization, not global optimum or measured learner time.
